about.heading: Registered Shops + Customers
about.para1: Shopping Saving connects consumers and registered shopkeepers through a managed business system. Consumers shop for daily essentials at registered shops in the company network.

para2.start: After a purchase, the record is saved in the company system. Eligibility, benefits and procedures follow company terms.
